tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us

tr.td: The urine findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant pyuria, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and hematuria. The causative organism is Klebsiella pneumoniae (>100,000 CFU/mL). No casts are seen, suggesting infection is likely limited to the lower urinary tract. Low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. Clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy are recommended.
